touches.body:
Hey Omar, quick favour? I saw Intercom is hiring a Senior Motion Designer, and I'm building Director, a motion-graphics editor where you direct the animation by voice and an AI does the keyframing. I'd love 15 minutes with Scott Smith to see whether it could take some of the launch-asset load off the Brand Studio. Would you be up for an intro? Here's a blurb you can paste:

"Scott, meet Akim. He's building Director, an AI motion-graphics editor you direct by voice; every AI change is a step you keep or undo. Thought it might help with the motion workload while you hire."
No pressure at all, Omar. If an intro feels like too much, I'd also love your honest take on whether Director would be useful for a team like yours.

review.note: Hiring claim is sourced. Heads-up: Scott Smith's title comes from an undated Intercom podcast, so ask Omar whether he's still the right person.

touches.subject: A faster way to ship Brand Studio motion
touches.body:
Hi Justin,

Customer.io is hiring a Senior Motion Designer, so it sounds like motion demand is outpacing the team. I'm building Director, an AI motion-graphics editor: you say what you want ("make the logo land with a little bounce"), it animates, and you keep or undo each change.

It isn't a replacement for a great motion designer, but it could let your brand designers handle the quick stuff. Worth a 15-minute look?

Akim
Hi Justin, I sent you a note about Director (an AI motion editor you direct by voice). Happy to share a short demo if that's useful for the Brand Studio.
